authorization: User accepted agent grading plus human disagreements/sample on September 27, 2026.
supersedes: The human_answer_review_required flag in archived final-v3-reviewed rubrics is superseded only for concordant agent judgments outside the sample and expansion set. Original keys and rubric content remain unchanged.
independence: Two fresh Codex agents, no implementation history, no access to one another's judgments or model/configuration/cost labels. Same underlying model family; not statistically independent error sources.
agreement: Every Boolean rubric criterion must match, with a nonempty reason per criterion and no uncertainty flags; otherwise human adjudication.
sample: One runtime-completed answer per each of the 11 tasks. Choose lowest SHA256 of sample-seed-0|task_id|config|rep. Fixed before outcomes; only runtime-failed attempts are ineligible for semantic review. Final sample selected after all attempts terminate.
expansion: If a sampled human verdict overturns agent unanimous pass/fail, require human review of every completed answer for that task across all four conditions and repetitions.
runtime_failures: Automatic failures; no model or human may override them as passes.
missing_or_stale_reviews: Pending, not passes or confirmed failures.
human_workload: At most 11 initial sample cases, plus disagreements, uncertainty and any task expansions; overlapping categories counted once.
cost_scope: Codex subscription grading usage is separate from the capped Anthropic evaluation API spend and will be disclosed.
no_tuning: No final-task outcomes used to change agent instructions, runtime or task keys. Any necessary correction requires a new version and separate results.
